''See also: [[Ozriel (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel is an [[Outsider]] and the eighth [[Judge]] of the [[Court]] of Seven. Known by the title the [[Destroyer]], he represents the conclusion of all existence across past, present, and future. While he maintains a human appearance, he possesses an unusual accent and has been seen wearing black armor with long, pale hair. He carries a scythe that interacts with the membrane protecting reality. Although he can appear lighthearted, Ozriel is a lethal threat who has stated his intention to erase the world and has been tasked with its [[destruction]]. He has warned that if certain names are used, he will destroy the world, and he is currently positioned in a way that threatens to break the shield protecting existence.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel possesses long, flowing white hair and is clad in black armor that appears smooth and liquid-like.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|An [[Outsider]] with the goal of killing everyone, Ozriel is described by [[Kelarac]] as a Furnace{{!}}furnace used for disposing of trash. He has discussed his professional responsibilities regarding things that escape and has engaged in consciousness-based conversation with [[Calder]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel utilizes a scythe that crackles against a blue membrane over reality and has the capacity to release his [[Intent]]. He is also capable of sending messages that become burned into the streets of a Capital.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel appears clad in liquid-like black armor with long, flowing white hair and possesses the ability to release his [[Intent]]. Having previously met with [[Calder]] to converse through consciousness alone, he is described by [[Kelarac]] as a Furnace{{!}}furnace for disposing of trash. While exchanging looks with [[Urg’naut]] across the abyss, Ozriel discussed his duty regarding things that escape. Outsider{{!}}The Outsider is revealed to be Ozriel, an entity who intends to kill everyone and sent a message that was burned into the streets of the Capital. He wields a scythe that crackles against a blue membrane over reality.}}
